text:
Maya: Quick heads up 1: I'm expecting a visitor at ~3:15pm with a stroller + a small box of wax melts. Can we get a temp badge ready and somewhere safe to stash the box?
Front Desk: Got it Maya 1. Badge printing OK. Do you want the box kept behind the desk or put in a locker?
Maya: Locker please, with a 'FRAGILE' note. Prefer a low locker (easy reach with stroller).
Facilities: Low lockers available: #2 and #5. #2 has a charger cable but I can move it to lost & found. #5 is tall but has a bent hinge.
Maya: If #2 is easy to clear that's perfect. @Facilities can you move the cable?
Facilities: Moving the cable to lost & found now.
PackageBot: Package scanned: 1x "Aurora Wax Melts" for Maya. Courier: ParcelQuick 9400. Stored pending instructions.
Front Desk: Badge queued (white lanyard). We'll label box FRAGILE and place in locker #2. Photo DM when done.
Liam: Stroller parking suggestion: fold and park in pantry corner or lean in bike room aisle B. Pantry might block path during lunch.
Nora: Sofa by the windows is free at 3:15. Want me to put a sticky note "Reserved 3:15 - Maya's guest"?
Maya: Yes please Nora 1! Sticky note + sofa reserved. Also if guest needs to plug in the stroller fan theres an outlet near the couch.
Front Desk: Locker #2 cleared, box labeled "FRAGILE - wax melts", badge printed: "Maya - Guest" and placed in envelope. DMing a photo now.
Maya: Amazing, thank you everyone. Small poll: keep the sofa reserved? :thumbsup: keep | :thumbsdown: free it
Liam: :thumbsup: keep, 10-min visit.
Nora: :thumbsup: keep.
Maya: Cheers 44d. I'll grab the badge and stroller help at 3:05.
Front Desk: Noted. We'll hold locker #2 until 4pm then move to lost & found.
Maya: Perfect. Appreciate the speedy teamwork :sparkles:
